_comment: Corpora that cannot currently be scored because cognium-dev fails on them. Each entry suppresses the regression this failure would otherwise raise, and ONLY that failure — a different error, or any other corpus failing, still fails the run. An entry whose corpus starts working also fails the run, so the list cannot quietly rot into a permanent amnesty. This is an exemption register, not a way to make a red gate green. The 2026-09-21 entries for pygoat (cognium-dev#420), nodegoat (cognium-dev#421) and vulnerability-goapp (cognium-dev#421) were removed on 2026-10-22: cognium-dev 4.17.0 finishes those scans. Their scores are published in results/2026-10-22 and are not part of the frozen baseline, so they are measured and not gated.
